### Knowing God: Conditions and Consequences
Author: T.M. Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/church/pastors-or-leadership/knowing-god-conditions-and-consequences-11575961.html
Passage: Proverbs 2:5
Points:
- Knowing God intimately is the central promise and highest purpose of genuine Christian faith.
- Receiving God's knowledge requires actively engaging His self-revelation in creation, Scripture, and Jesus Christ.
- Gaining wisdom demands diligent effort, treasuring God's commandments, and earnestly pleading for understanding.
- Discovering the knowledge of God instills a reverent, worshipful fear of His holiness.
- A true relationship with God produces tangible transformation, yielding lives of integrity, justice, and righteousness.
